t: What the whole thing is compared to
a: تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ الْجَسَدِ
p: Tara-l-muʾminīna fī tarāḥumihim wa tawāddihim wa taʿāṭufihim ka-mathali-l-jasad
m: You see the believers in their mercy to one another, their love for one another and their kindness to one another, like a single body.
